jale_billing_internal.billing_enforce_or.arguments: p_organization_id uuid, p_active_job_limit integer, p_foreman_seat_limit integer
jale_billing_internal.billing_enforce_or.returns: TABLE(paused_count integer, paused_titles text[], suspended_count integer, suspended_emails text[], revoked_invite_count integer, owner_email text)
jale_billing_internal.billing_enforce_or.reason: On a reducing subscription status, under the company lock: first suspends (and marks billing_suspended_at on) its most recently joined foremen over the seat limit, then pauses jobs over the job limit, keeping active members' oldest jobs first so a suspended foreman's jobs go before the owner's (a job_status_events row each, a removed visibility event for a public one), and revokes its newest live invites over the seats left.

jale_billing_internal.billing_restore_or.arguments: p_organization_id uuid, p_active_job_limit integer, p_foreman_seat_limit integer
jale_billing_internal.billing_restore_or.returns: TABLE(resumed_count integer, resumed_titles text[], restored_count integer, restored_emails text[], owner_email text)
jale_billing_internal.billing_restore_or.reason: On an entitled subscription status, under the company lock: restores the company's billing-suspended foremen (marked billing_suspended_at, earliest marked then earliest joined) into the seats left, then resumes the billing-paused jobs of its active members oldest first.
